notes: Commit 7c1dc1c (#1616, 11 Nov 2026 PST) adds one bullet to docs/contributor_guide/device-driver-guide.md. The bullet says: restore lifecycle changes in stop() and per-command changes before the command finishes; save the original values and restore them exactly, not assumed defaults; and run cleanup on errors, cancellation and partial setup failures. All three claims match.

Code at c5386e8 confirms all of it: UDP port 34569 with bdc_ pairs (ipaddress, systemid, modulename, macaddress); TCP port 24652 with CRLF ASCII lines and no handshake or keepalive; resolve_host; and the router docstring on in-flight commands and the 'STAR V over a socket'. One caveat: id-based reply routing and the STAR V docstring were already in router.py. #1556 adds the TCP transport, discovery and an owner-loop reader, so 'new code' applies to the transport and discovery, not to the id matching.
